regions.merged_text: God bless you and yours, I hope you are well. I hope too that I may not be presuming too much in asking your- self of whom I have only heard, to guide the bearer, honest Edmund Walsh to employment, if you have anything in view. I would appreciate anything you might find convenient to do for him.
